IDEA 1: combined plot
```{r}
method_names <- c(
  "fixed_crn" = "fCRN",      
  "adaptive_crn"  = "aCRN",
  "fixed_het"      = "fHet",
  "adaptive_het"   = "aHet",
  "fixed_crn_seed" = "fgCRN"
)


dfx <- search_space(all_out_lists[[31]], nout=5)
dfx$method <- factor(method_names[dfx$method], levels=c("aCRN", "fHet", "aHet", "fgCRN", "fCRN"))

ggplot_colors_5 <- c("#F8766D", "#A3A500", "#00BF7D", "#00B0F6", "#E76BF3")

fig <- plot_ly(
  dfx %>% filter(iter>1, time<=300),
  x = ~rep,
  y = ~p1,
  z = ~p2,
  color = ~method,
  colors = ggplot_colors_5,
  type = "scatter3d",
  mode = "markers",
  marker = list(size = 3)
) %>%
  layout(
    scene = list(
      camera = list(
          eye = list(x = 1.75, y = 2, z = 0.25)  # Set viewpoint vector
        ),
      xaxis = list(title = list(text = "Random seed"), range=c(1,1000), autorange = "reversed"),
      yaxis = list(title = "Recovery Rate", range=c(0,1)),  # β (beta)
      zaxis = list(title = "Infection Rate", range=c(0,1))   # γ (gamma)
      #yaxis = list(title = "\u03B2", range=c(0,1)),  # β (beta)
      #zaxis = list(title = "\u03B3", range=c(0,1))   # γ (gamma)
    )
  )

fig
```



```{r}
plot_ly(
      data = dfx %>% filter(method==method_name, iter>1),
      x = ~rep,
      y = ~p1,
      z = ~p2,
      type = "scatter3d",
      mode = "markers",
      marker = list(size = 4, color="black")
    ) %>%
    layout(
      title = list(
        text = method_name,
        y = 0.75,         # ← lower value moves it closer to plot
        x = .6,          # center horizontally
        xanchor = "center",
        yanchor = "top",
        font = list(size = 16)
      ),
      scene = list(
        camera = list(
          eye = list(x = 1.75, y = 2, z = 0.25)  # Set viewpoint vector
        ),
        xaxis = list(title = list(text = "Random seed"), range=c(1000,1)),
        yaxis = list(title = "\u03B2", range=c(0,1)),  # β (beta)
        zaxis = list(title = "\u03B3", range=c(0,1))   # γ (gamma)
      )
    )
```

```{r}
dfx = dfx %>% mutate(
  β = p1, 
  γ = p2,
  r = rep
)

dfx <- rbind(dfx, dfx %>% filter(method=="aCRN", iter==1) %>% mutate(method="Initial Design"))
dfx$method <- factor(dfx$method, levels = c("aHet", "fHet", "Initial Design", "aCRN", "fCRN", "fgCRN"))

library("lattice")
cloud(β ~ r * γ | method, data = dfx)
```


```{r}
library(htmlwidgets)
library(webshot)

# split your data by the faceting variable (e.g., method)

for (method_name in method_names) {
  fig <- plot_ly(
      data = dfx %>% filter(method==method_name, iter>1),
      x = ~rep,
      y = ~p1,
      z = ~p2,
      type = "scatter3d",
      mode = "markers",
      marker = list(size = 4, color="black", alpha=.1)
    ) %>%
    layout(
      title = list(
        text = method_name,
        y = 1.5,         # ← lower value moves it closer to plot
        x = 0.5,          # center horizontally
        xanchor = "center",
        yanchor = "top",
        font = list(size = 20)
      ),
      scene = list(
        camera = list(
          eye = list(x = 1, y = 1.5, z = .1)  # Set viewpoint vector
        ),
        xaxis = list(title = list(text = "Seed"), range=c(1000,1)),
        #yaxis = list(title = "Recovery Rate", range=c(0,1)),  # β (beta)
        #zaxis = list(title = "Infection Rate", range=c(0,1))   # γ (gamma)
        yaxis = list(title = "\u03B2", range=c(0,1)),  # β (beta)
        zaxis = list(title = "\u03B3", range=c(0,1))   # γ (gamma)
      )
    )
  htmlwidgets::saveWidget(as_widget(fig), paste0(method_name, "_3D_bw.html"))
}

```

```{r}
method_name = 'aHet'

x <- dfx %>% filter(method==method_name) %>% pull('p1')
y <- dfx %>% filter(method==method_name) %>% pull('p2')
s <- subplot(
    plot_ly(x = x, color = I("black"), type = 'histogram'), 
    plotly_empty(), 
    plot_ly(x = x, y = y, type = 'histogram2dcontour', showscale = F), 
    plot_ly(y = y, color = I("black"), type = 'histogram'),
  nrows = 2, heights = c(0.2, 0.8), widths = c(0.8, 0.2), 
  shareX = TRUE, shareY = TRUE, titleX = FALSE, titleY = FALSE
)

fig <- layout(s, showlegend = FALSE)

fig
```


```{r}
library(ggExtra)

method_name = 'aHet'
# Base ggplot: 2D density plot with filled contours
plot_list <- list() 
for (m in method_names){
  p <- ggplot(dfx %>% filter(method==method_name) , aes(x = p1, y = p2)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0) +  # invisible points to satisfy ggMarginal
  stat_density_2d(aes(fill = after_stat(level)), geom = "polygon", color = "black") +
  #geom_density_2d_filled() +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "plasma") +
  title(m) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

  # Add marginal histograms
  p <- ggMarginal(p, type = "histogram", fill = "grey20", color = "black")
  plot_list[[length(plot_list)+1]] <- p
}


```


```{r}
ggplot(dfx, aes(x = p1, y = p2)) + 
  geom_point(alpha = .1) +
  stat_density_2d(aes(fill = after_stat(level)), geom = "polygon", color = "black") +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "plasma") +
  facet_wrap(~method) + 
  theme_bw()
```

```{r}
method_names <- c(
  "fixed_crn" = "fCRN",      
  "adaptive_crn"  = "aCRN",
  "fixed_het"      = "fHet",
  "adaptive_het"   = "aHet",
  "fixed_crn_seed" = "fgCRN"
)






plot_list <- list()

for (m in c("aCRN", "fgCRN", "fCRN", "aHet", "fHet")) {
  p <- ggplot(dfx %>% filter(method == m, iter>1), aes(x = p1, y = p2)) +
    geom_point(alpha = .1) +
    stat_density_2d(aes(fill = after_stat(level)), geom = "polygon", color = "black") +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "plasma") +
    theme_bw() +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = Inf, y = -Inf,                # top-left corner
      label = m,
      hjust = 1.1, vjust = -0.5,        # adjust inward for padding
      size = 4.5, fontface = "bold"
    ) +
    theme(legend.position = "none")


  # Add marginal histograms
  p_marginal <- ggMarginal(p, type = "histogram", fill = "grey20", color = "black")

  # No need to convert — cowplot::plot_grid handles gtables
  plot_list[[length(plot_list) + 1]] <- p_marginal
}

# add initial design for comparison
p <- ggplot(dfx %>% filter(method=='aCRN', iter == 1), aes(x = p1, y = p2)) +
    geom_point(alpha = .1) +
    #stat_density_2d(aes(fill = after_stat(level)), geom = "polygon", color = "black") +
    #scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "plasma") +
    theme_bw() +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = Inf, y = -Inf,                # top-left corner
      label = "Initial Design",
      hjust = 1.05, vjust = -0.5,        # adjust inward for padding
      size = 4.5, fontface = "bold"
    )+
    theme(legend.position = "none")

  # Add marginal histograms
  p_marginal <- ggMarginal(p, type = "histogram", fill = "grey20", color = "black")

  # No need to convert — cowplot::plot_grid handles gtables
  plot_list[[length(plot_list) + 1]] <- p_marginal

# Arrange in a grid
plot_grid(plotlist = plot_list, ncol = 3)

```
